description: This header file defines functions, macros, and constants related to speed density calculations in an engine control system, including conversions between units and functions for retrieving and initializing speed density parameters.

methods.name: getTCharge
methods.description: Calculates the total charge based on RPM, throttle position, and temperature readings.

methods.name: getCylinderAirMass
methods.description: Calculates the mass of air in a cylinder based on volumetric efficiency, manifold absolute pressure, and temperature.

methods.name: sdMath
methods.description: Performs speed density related calculations involving air mass and AFR.

methods.name: setDefaultVETable
methods.description: Sets the default volumetric efficiency table.

methods.name: initSpeedDensity
methods.description: Initializes the speed density calculation module.

methods.name: getSpeedDensityFuel
methods.description: Calculates fuel based on speed density parameters.
